articles.summary: Firefly's fourth Blue Ghost lunar mission will deliver and operate two rovers and three scientific instruments on the Moon's south pole.
articles.title: Firefly Awarded $177 Million NASA Contract for Mission to the Moon’s South Pole

articles.summary: Firefly today filed a registration statement relating to a proposed IPO and intends to list on the Nasdaq under the $FLY ticker symbol.
articles.title: Firefly Aerospace Files Registration Statement for Proposed Initial Public Offering

articles.summary: Firefly has launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of 16,200,000 shares of its common stock.
articles.title: Firefly Aerospace Announces Launch of Initial Public Offering
